items.title: “Big Short” Investor: Big Tech Could Return to “Positive Cash Flow” in 2027. Meta Gains Most
items.summary: Key TakeawaysSteve Eisman says AI capex could peak in 2027, and the hyperscalers could return to positive cash flow as soon as the second half of that year, if data center construction slows. Charlie Bilello says Meta spends 43% of its revenue on capex, compared with 39% for Microsoft, 34% for Alphabet and 27% for Amazon, so a slowdown would free up the largest share of revenue at Meta.
